title: On the Hausdorff Dimension of weighted exactly Approximable Vectors
summary: We show that the Hausdorff dimension of $\boldsymbol w$-weighted $τ$-exactly approximable vectors in $\mathbb R^d$ coincides with the Hausdorff dimension of $\boldsymbol w$-weighted $τ$-approximable vectors, generalizing a result of the first named author and De Saxcé.
